text: Digital strategy is tied to measurable institutional outcomes.
Technology portfolio priorities are governed with explicit value and risk criteria.
Major initiatives have accountable executive sponsors and benefits owners.
Investment decisions use business cases and post-implementation value reviews.
Critical data domains have accountable owners and quality controls.
Master/reference data is governed across systems.
Decision makers can access timely, trusted analytics.
Data architecture supports integration, lineage and scalable reporting.
Architecture principles guide major solution decisions.
APIs/integration patterns reduce point-to-point dependency.
Application portfolios have lifecycle/technical-debt visibility.
Interoperability and non-functional requirements are designed early.
Cross-functional teams can deliver in increments with clear acceptance criteria.
Programs track dependencies, risks, decisions and benefits.
Product/service ownership continues after go-live.
Release, test and production-readiness controls are repeatable.
Security and privacy are built into solution lifecycles.
Identity/access controls reflect least privilege and role ownership.
Continuity, recovery and resilience expectations are tested.
Technology risks are visible at executive governance level.
Stakeholder groups are mapped and actively engaged.
Training, communications and adoption measures are part of delivery.
Teams have clear decision rights and capability-development plans.
Operational ownership and knowledge transfer are explicit before handover.
AI use cases are selected against business value and risk.
AI systems have accountable owners, data controls and human oversight.
AI risks are documented, monitored and reassessed over the lifecycle.
Generative-AI use considers privacy, security, evaluation and misuse controls.
Services are designed around user needs rather than internal silos.
Shared platforms/components are reused where appropriate.
Public-sector data is treated as a strategic asset with governance.
Digital services are designed to become more proactive and interoperable over time.
